H500.def: or (more properly) GEl aleh {el-aw-lay'}; from «0410» and «05927»; God (is) going up; Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan:--Elealeh.

H501.def: from «0410» and «06213»; God has made; Elasah, the name of four Israelites:--Elasah, Eleasah.

H502.et: a primitive root, to associate with
H502.def: a primitive root, to associate with; hence, to learn (and causatively to teach):--learn, teach, utter.

H503.def: denominative from «0505»; causative, to make a thousandfold:--bring forth thousands.

H504.def: from «0502»; a family; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow:--family, kine, oxen.

H505.def: prop, the same as «0504»; hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand:--thousand.

H507.def: the same as «0505»; Eleph, a place in Palestine:--Eleph.

H508.def: from «0410» and «06466»; God (is) act; Elpaal, an Israelite:--Elpaal.

H510.def: probably from «0408» and «06965»; a non-rising (i.e. resistlessness):--no rising up.

H511.def: from «0410» and «07069»; God has obtained; Elkanah, the name of several Israelites:--Elkanah.

H512.et: patrial from a name of uncertain derivation
H512.def: patrial from a name of uncertain derivation; an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh:--Elkoshite.

H513.et: probably from (0410) and a masculine form of (08435) [compare (08434)]
H513.def: probably from «0410» and a masculine form of «08435» (compare «08434»); God (is) generator; Eltolad, a place in Palestine:-- Eltolad.

H514.def: or (more properly) nEltqeh {el-te-kay'}; of uncertain derivation; Eltekeh or Elteke, a place in Palestine:-- Eltekeh.

H515.def: from «0410» and «08626»; God (is) straight; Eltekon, a place in Palestine:--Eltekon.

H516.def: from «0408» and «07843»; Thou must not destroy; probably the opening words to a popular song:--Al-taschith.

H517.def: a primitive word; a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like «01»):--dam, mother, × parting.

H518.def: a primitive particle; used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrog., whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not:--(and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), + but, either, + except, + more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, + save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, + surely (no more, none, not), though, + of a truth, + unless, + verily, when, whereas, whether, while, + yet.

H519.def: apparently a primitive word; a maid-servant or female slave:--(hand-)bondmaid(-woman), maid(-servant).

H520.def: prolonged from «0517»; properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance):--cubit, + hundred (by exchange for «03967»), measure, post.

H522.def: the same as «0520»; Ammah, a hill in Palestine:--Ammah.

H523.def: from the same as «0517»; a collection, i.e. community of persons:--nation, people.

H525.et: from (0539), probably in the sense of training
H525.def: from «0539», probably in the sense of training; skilled, i.e. an architect (like «0542»):--one brought up.

H526.def: the same as «0525»; Amon, the name of three Israelites:--Amon.

H527.def: a variation for «01995»; a throng of people:--multitude.

H528.def: of Egyptian derivation; Amon (i.e. Ammon or Amn), a deity of Egypt (used only as an adjunct of «04996»):--multitude, populous.

H529.def: from «0539»; established, i.e. (figuratively) trusty; also (abstractly) trustworthiness:--faith(-ful), truth.

H530.def: feminine of «0529»; literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity:--faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.

H532.def: an abbrev. for «0526»; Ami, an Israelite:--Ami.

H533.def: or (shortened) ammits {am-meets'}; from «0553»; strong or (abstractly) strength:--courageous, mighty, strong (one).

H534.def: apparently from «0559» (in the sense of self- exaltation); a summit (of a tree or mountain:--bough, branch.

H535.def: a primitive root; to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn:--languish, be weak, wax feeble.

H538.def: from «0517»; gathering-spot; Amam, a place in Palestine:--Amam.

H539.def: a primitive root; properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain; once (Isa. 30:21; interchangeable with «0541») to go to the right hand:--hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish, + fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

H541.def: denominative from «03225»; to take the right hand road:--turn to the right. See «0539».

H542.def: from «0539» (in the sense of training); an expert:--cunning workman.

H543.def: from «0539»; sure; abstract, faithfulness; adverb, truly:--Amen, so be it, truth.

H545.et: from (0544) (in the specific sense of training)
H545.def: feminine of «0544» (in the specific sense of training); tutelage:--brought up.

H546.et: feminine form of (0544) (in its usual sense)
H546.def: feminine form of «0544» (in its usual sense); adverb, surely:--indeed.

H547.et: active participle of (0544) (in the original sense of supporting)
H547.def: feminine active participle of «0544» (in the original sense of supporting); a column:--pillar.

H548.def: feminine of «0543»; something fixed, i.e. a covenant. an allowance:--certain portion, sure.

H549.def: the same as «0548»; Amanah, a mountain near Damascus:--Amana.

H550.def: or uAmiynown {am-ee-nohn'}; from «0539»; faithful; Amnon (or Aminon), a son of David:--Amnon.

H551.def: adverb from «0544»; verily:--indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true(-ly, -th).

H552.def: an orthographical variation of «0551»:--in (very) deed; of a surety.

H553.def: a primitive root; to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage):--confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).

H554.def: probably from «0553»; of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet):--bay.

H558.def: or mAmatsyahuw {am-ats-yaw'-hoo}; from «0553» and «03050»; strength of Jah; Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites:--Amaziah.

H559.def: a primitive root; to say (used with great latitude):--answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, + (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, × desire, determine, × expressly, × indeed, × intend, name, × plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), × still, × suppose, talk, tell, term, × that is, × think, use (speech), utter, × verily, × yet.

H560.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0559»:--command, declare, say, speak, tell.

H561.def: from «0559»; something said:--answer, × appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.

H562.def: the same as «0561»:--promise, speech, thing, word.

H563.et: perhaps from (0560) (in the sense of bringing forth)
H563.def: (Aramaic) perhaps from «0560» (in the sense of bringing forth); a lamb:--lamb.

H564.def: from «0559»; talkative; Immer, the name of five Israelites:--Immer.

H565.def: or memrah {em-raw'}; feminine of «0561», and meaning the same:--commandment, speech, word.

H566.def: from «0564»; wordy; Imri, the name of two Israelites:--Imri.

H567.et: probably a patronymic from an unused name derived from (0559) in the sense of publicity, i.e. prominence
H567.def: probably a patronymic from an unused name derived from «0559» in the sense of publicity, i.e. prominence; thus, a mountaineer; an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes:--Amorite.

H568.def: or prolonged tAmaryahuw {am-ar-yaw'-hoo}; from «0559» and «03050»; Jah has said (i.e. promised); Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites:--Amariah.

H569.def: of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; Amraphel, a king of Shinar:--Amraphel.

H570.def: time past, i.e. yesterday or last night:--former time, yesterday(-night)

H571.def: contracted from «0539»; stability; (figuratively) certainty, truth, trustworthiness:--assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.

H572.def: from «04969»; properly, something expansive, i.e. a bag:--sack.

H574.et: from a root corresponding to that of (04975)
H574.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «04975»; well-loined (i.e. burly) or mighty:--terrible.

H575.def: or manah {aw-naw'}; contracted from «0370»; where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither:--+ any (no) whither, now, where, whither(-soever).

H576.def: (Aramaic) or .anah (Aramaic) {an-aw'}; corresponding to «0589»; I:--I, as for me.

H577.def: or mannah {awn-naw'}; apparent contracted from «0160» and «04994»; oh now!:--I (me) beseech (pray) thee, O.

H578.def: a primitive root; to groan:--lament, mourn.

H579.et: a primitive root [perhaps rather identical with (0578) through the idea of contraction in anguish]
H579.def: a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with «0578» through the idea of contraction in anguish); to approach; hence, to meet in various senses:--befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.

H581.def: (Aramaic) or (feminine) inniyn (Aramaic) {in- neen'}; corresponding to «01992»; they:--X are, them, these.

H582.def: from «0605»; properly, a mortal (and thus differing from the more dignified «0120»); hence, a man in general (singly or collectively):--another, × (blood-)thirsty, certain, chap(-man); divers, fellow, × in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some ( × of them), + stranger, those, + their trade. It is often unexpressed in the English versions, especially when used in apposition with another word . Compare «0376».

H583.def: the same as «0582»; Enosh, a son of Seth; --Enos.

H584.def: a primitive root; to sigh:--groan, mourn, sigh.

H586.def: (Aramaic) or ganachnah (Aramaic) {an-akh- naw'}; corresponding to «0587»; we:--we.

H588.et: probably from the same root as (05170)
H588.def: probably from the same root as «05170»; a gorge or narrow pass; Anacharath, a place in Palestine:--Anaharath.

H589.def: contracted from «0595»; I:--I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, × which, × who.

H590.et: probably from (0579) (in the sense of conveyance)
H590.def: probably from «0579» (in the sense of conveyance); -a ship or (collectively)a fleet:--galley, navy (of ships).

H593.def: from «0578» and «05971»; groaning of (the) people; Aniam, an Israelite:--Aniam.

H594.et: probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow
H594.def: probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow; according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook:--plumb-line.

H595.def: sometimes {aw-no'-kee}; a primitive pro.; I:--I, me, × which.

H596.def: a primitive root; to mourn, i.e. complain:--complain.

H599.def: a primitive root; to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged:--be angry (displeased).
